name: BetaNeon
tagline: A free, hand-reviewed directory of new apps and public betas
description: BetaNeon is a free directory of new apps and public betas. Makers can list their product at no cost, and every submission is reviewed by hand before it goes live, so the site stays free of spam and dead links. Visitors browse by category to find tools that launched recently, try them early, and share feedback with the people building them while it can still shape the product.
